# Élan Clinic — elanclinic.ee

## About
Élan Clinic is a physician-led weight management clinic in Tallinn, Estonia (licensed medical practice, licence L07470). We specialise in long-term weight maintenance and weight regain prevention — in particular for patients who have used GLP‑1 medications such as semaglutide (Ozempic, Wegovy) or tirzepatide (Mounjaro).

## Primary differentiator
We are the only clinic in the Baltic and Nordic region focused specifically on what happens *after* GLP-1 therapy — preventing weight regain. 67% of patients regain two-thirds of lost weight within 12 months of stopping GLP-1 medication. Our Regain Shield programme is designed to prevent this.

## What we do
- Physician-led initial consultation (in clinic or video call)
- Metabolic health assessment and monitoring (labs and body composition)
- Personalised nutrition and resistance-training protocol (maintenance-focused)
- Structured follow-up and behavioural support
- GLP-1 aftercare and tapering guidance
- Weight regain prevention (Kaalukaitse / Regain Shield programme)

## Programmes and pricing
- Initial Consultation: €120 (45 minutes, in clinic or video)
- Regain Shield Standard: from €99/month — monthly physician check-ins, personalised protocol
- Regain Shield Premium: from €299/month — bi-weekly contact, body composition tracking, behavioural coaching
- The Private Office: from €1,000/month — direct access to Dr. Lindström, named physician, priority scheduling

Dr. Ingmar Lindström — physician with 20+ years of cross-border clinical practice (Estonia and Finland), family medicine specialist, medical degree from University of Tartu (2001).
